blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Uncertainty estimation in machine learning typically decomposes uncertainty into aleatoric uncertainty (AU) and epistemic uncertainty (EU) using the standard information-theoretic framework. However, in practice, two critical issues arise: entanglement (AU and EU are highly correlated) and epistemic collapse (EU magnitude shrinks with increasing model capacity). We analyze this framework on a functional level and discover that significant portions of the assumed AU, EU range are infeasible in finite settings, and cannot be attained with any class probabilities. We characterize how this infeasible region scales with the number of classes and Monte Carlo samples N N (e.g., from ensembles with N N members), revealing it is bounded by AU ≤ log ⁡ ( 2 ) / N \text{AU}\leq\log(2)/N . Crucially, the infeasible region’s boundary helps explain epistemic collapse: when model confidence is high, AU > EU \text{AU}>\text{EU} is guaranteed by this fundamental structural limitation. Our findings show that increasing ensemble size mitigates epistemic collapse by reducing the infeasible area. Lastly, we caution against interpreting AU and EU as independent quantities in low AU regimes, since we show they are coupled when AU ≤ log ⁡ ( 2 ) / N \text{AU}\leq\log(2)/N .
blocks.zh: 机器学习中的不确定性估计通常会利用标准的信息-理论框架将不确定性分解为厌倦不确定性(AU)和感知不确定性(EU). 然而,在实践中,出现了两个关键问题:缠绕(非盟和欧盟密切相关)和感官崩溃(欧盟规模随着模型能力的提高而缩小)。 我们从职能层面分析这一框架,发现假定的非盟、欧盟范围中有相当一部分在有限的环境下不可行,任何类别概率都无法实现。 我们描述这个不可行的区域如何以类别数量和蒙特卡洛N样本(例如来自与N成员合唱团的N样本)来衡量,揭示它以AU \\ x(2)/N\text{AU}\leq\log(2)/N为界。 关键是,不可行的区域边界有助于解释感官崩溃的原因:当模型信任度高时,欧盟\text{AU\\text{EU}受到这一基本结构限制的保障。 我们的研究结果表明,日益扩大的综艺体积通过减少不可行的面积来缓解癫痫崩溃。 最后,我们告诫不要将非盟和欧盟解释为非盟低层政权中的独立数量,因为当非盟的“对数”(2)/N\text{AU}\leq\log(2)/N)时,我们显示它们相互配合。

blocks.en: Predictive uncertainty is commonly decomposed into aleatoric uncertainty (AU), associated with ambiguity in the data, and epistemic uncertainty (EU), associated with limited model knowledge. This distinction is important because it can lead to different decisions in downstream uncertainty estimation tasks (e.g. out-of-distribution detection, calibration, ambiguity modeling).
blocks.zh: 预测性的不确定性通常被分解为与数据模糊相关的机能不确定性(AU)和与模型知识有限相关的感知不确定性(EU). 这种区分很重要,因为它可以导致下游不确定性估计任务的不同决定(如分配外检测,校准,模具模糊).

blocks.en: For a finite set of model predictions, the standard information-theoretic decomposition ( Houlsby et al., 2011 ; Kendall and Gal, 2017 ; Depeweg et al., 2018 ) defines total uncertainty (TU) as the entropy of the mean predictive distribution, AU as the mean entropy of individual predictions, and EU as the difference between TU and AU. We use posterior sample broadly for each predictive distribution in this finite set: it may be generated by an approximate Bayesian method, such as MC dropout or SWAG, or by an ensemble member. Despite its widespread use, studies report strong empirical correlation and entanglement between AU and EU and question whether the measures consistently isolate their intended uncertainty sources ( Wimmer et al., 2023 ; Mucsányi et al., 2024 ; Kahl et al., 2024 ; Christensen et al., 2026 ; Baur et al., 2026 ) . A related concern is epistemic uncertainty collapse: EU can decrease as model capacity increases, even when limitations in training data or distribution shift persist ( Fellaji and Pennerath, 2024 ; Kirsch, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 对于一组有限的模型预测,标准的信息-理论分解(Houlsby等人,2011年;Kendall and Gal,2017年;Depeweg等人,2018年)定义了完全不确定性(TU)为平均预测分布的 en,AU为个人预测的平均值 en,欧盟为TU和AU的区别. 我们广泛使用后面的样本来进行这个有限的组合中的每个预测分布:它可能由一种大致的贝叶斯方法产生,如MC退出或SWAG,或者由一个综艺成员产生. 尽管广泛使用,但研究报告表明,非盟和欧盟之间有着很强的经验关联和纠缠,并质疑这些措施是否始终孤立其预期的不确定性来源(Wimmer等人,2023年;Mucsányi等人,2024年;Kahl等人,2024年;Christensen等人,2026年;Baur等人,2026年)。 一个相关的关注是认知不确定性崩溃:欧盟可以随着模型容量的增加而减少,即使培训数据或分布转移的限制仍然存在(Fellaji and Pennerath, 2024;Kirsch, 2025).

blocks.en: We show that the functional dependence of AU and EU partly explains these shortcomings. Figure 1 plots ( AU , EU ) (\text{AU},\text{EU}) pairs for synthetic probabilities drawn from correlated Gaussian logits for two scenarios and for predictions from a trained ensemble. The points follow a parametric form that results directly from the information theoretic decomposition. Moreover, it can be seen that depending on the choice of number of classes C C and number of posterior samples N N , certain areas of the plane are infeasible . Further details of the simulation are provided in Appendix A . These observations motivate a systematic analysis of the uncertainty space.

blocks.en: • We establish bounds on the attainable ( AU , TU ) (\text{AU},\text{TU}) space for finite sets of posterior samples, exposing regions that cannot be realized. The fraction of epistemic uncertainty grows with N N , while the epistemic uncertainty fraction shrinks for larger (more confident) models. blocks.en: 2.2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2.2 相关工作

blocks.en: The information-theoretic decomposition has received increasing scrutiny. Wimmer et al. (2023) analyze whether conditional entropy and mutual information have the properties expected of AU and EU. Their theoretical and empirical results identify discrepancies between the measures and the intended uncertainty sources, raising questions about whether the additive decomposition separates AU and EU faithfully.
blocks.zh: 信息理论分解受到越来越多的审查。 Wimmer等人(2023年)分析了有条件的py和相互信息是否具有非盟和欧盟期望的属性. 它们的理论和经验结果查明了措施与预期的不确定性来源之间的差异,并提出了添加剂分解是否将非盟和欧盟忠实分开的问题。

blocks.en: Mucsányi et al. (2024) report strong correlations between estimated AU and EU across uncertainty-estimation methods for image classification. They discuss this association as evidence of limited disentanglement and emphasize task-specific evaluation. For semantic segmentation, Kahl et al. (2024) introduce ValUES, a framework for evaluating uncertainty estimates under ambiguity and distribution shift. Their results show that disentanglement in simulated data does not consistently transfer to real data. EU measures can also capture annotator disagreement and successful disentanglement depends on the data and evaluation setting. Other studies have highlighted similar challenges in disentangling different sources of uncertainty, emphasizing the need for careful interpretation and evaluation of information-theoretic measures ( Baur et al., 2026 ; Christensen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: Mucsányi等人(2024年)报告说,估计的非盟和欧盟在图像分类的不确定性估计方法方面有着很强的相互关系。 他们将这种联系作为有限脱节的证据加以讨论,并强调具体任务评价。 对于语义分解,Kahl等人(2024年)引入了ValUES,这是在模糊和分布变化下评价不确定性估计的一个框架. 其结果显示,模拟数据中的脱节不能始终向真实数据转移. 欧盟的措施还可以抓住注释者的分歧,成功的分散取决于数据和评价环境。 其他研究强调了在排除不同不确定性来源方面的类似挑战,强调需要认真解释和评估信息理论措施(Baur等人,2026年;Christensen等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: A further concern is epistemic uncertainty collapse, in which estimated EU decreases despite persistent limitations in training information. Fellaji and Pennerath (2024) describe an “epistemic uncertainty hole” in which EU becomes small as model size increases, including with limited training data, and examine its effect on out-of-distribution detection. Kirsch (2025) proposes implicit ensembling as a possible mechanism: averaging within larger networks may reduce disagreement between ensemble members. The authors provide experimental evidence based on ensembles of ensembles and wider networks that is consistent with this hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 还有一个令人关切的问题是普遍存在的不确定性崩溃,尽管培训信息持续有限,但欧盟估计会减少。 Fellaji和Pennerath(2024年)描述了一个“流行病不确定性洞”,随着模型大小的增加,包括培训数据有限,欧盟变得很小,并审查了其对扩散外检测的影响。 Kirsch(2025年)提议隐含的综艺作为可能的机制:在更大的网络内平均可以减少综艺成员之间的分歧. 作者根据合唱团的合唱团和符合这个假设的更广泛的网络提供实验证据.

blocks.en: Closely related mathematical work studies entropy-bounded information maximization. Ebrahimi et al. (2024) maximize mutual information between a source variable with a prescribed distribution and an output variable subject to an output-entropy constraint. Taking the source to be a uniformly sampled prediction index and the output to be the predicted class identifies these quantities with EU and TU, respectively. At fixed TU, maximizing EU is equivalent to minimizing AU. They characterize optimal perturbations near deterministic mappings and propose an envelope construction whose global optimality remains conjectural. Our analysis examines the attainable uncertainty region for equally weighted finite sets of posterior samples, including its dependence on sample count and class count, and connects this geometry to epistemic uncertainty collapse.
blocks.zh: 紧密相连的数学工作研究 entropy约束信息最大化. Ebrahimi等人(2024年)在具有规定分布的源变量和受输出-内质制约的输出变量之间最大限度地实现了相互信息. 将源作为统一的抽样预测指数,将输出作为预测类分别用欧盟和TU识别这些量. 在固定的TU,最大化欧盟相当于最小化非盟. 它们是确定性制图附近最佳扰动的特征,并提出一个信封结构,其全球最佳性仍为猜想。 我们的分析研究了可实现的不确定性区域,用于同样加权的有限系列后期样本,包括其对样本数和类数的依赖,并将这一几何学与感知不确定性崩溃联系起来。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: To evaluate the impact of ensemble size and network capacity on uncertainty estimation, we conduct a series of experiments varying these factors systematically. Our aim is to understand how these factors relate to epistemic collapse, i.e., the reduction of epistemic uncertainty, commonly observed when model capacity grows.
blocks.zh: 为了评价综艺体积和网络能力对不确定性估计的影响,我们进行了一系列系统性地改变这些因素的实验。 我们的目的是了解这些因素与感知性崩溃有何关系,即当模型能力增强时通常观察到的感知性不确定性的减少.

blocks.en: Our theory suggests that when AU is low, there is a direct dependence between AU and EU since some pairs of (AU,EU) are infeasible. This dependence could relate to the observed entanglement in uncertainty estimation. For this, we track performance for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection as it allows us to assess the entanglement between AU and EU in practice. For OOD detection, we expect EU to be more informative than AU, and we therefore say that there is entanglement when AU performance exceeds EU performance. For OOD detection, we designate the final three classes of each dataset as OOD and the remaining classes as in-distribution (ID). We use EU to score OOD examples and report the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC).
blocks.zh: 我们的理论认为,当非盟较低时,非盟和欧盟之间存在直接的依赖关系,因为一些对(非盟、欧盟)是行不通的。 这种依赖性可能与观察到的不确定性估计中的缠绕有关。 为此,我们追踪分配外(OO)检测的绩效,因为它使我们能够在实践中评估非盟和欧盟之间的纠缠。 关于OOD检测,我们期望欧盟比非盟提供更多信息,因此,我们说,当非盟的表现超过欧盟的表现时,就存在纠缠。 关于OOD检测,我们指定每个数据集的最后三个类别为OOD,其余类别为分布式(ID). 我们使用欧盟来评分OOD实例,并报告接收器操作特征曲线下的区域(AUROC).

blocks.en: We evaluate on CIFAR-10 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) and MNIST ( LeCun et al., 1998 ) using EfficientNet ( Tan and Le, 2019 ) models B0 (4.02M parameters), B2 (7.72M), B4 (17.57M), and B6 (40.76M). We estimate uncertainty using either deep ensembles ( Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017 ) or Monte Carlo (MC) dropout ( Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ) . For MC dropout, we enable dropout at test time and insert layers with rate p = 0.2 p=0.2 before each SiLU activation in EfficientNet. All results are shown on validation data using standard splits.
blocks.zh: 我们利用高效网络(Tan和Le,2019年)B0(4.02M参数)、B2(7.72M)、B4(17.57M)和B6(40.76M)对CIFAR-10(Krizhevsky,2009年)和MNIST(LeCun等人,1998年)进行了评估。 使用深层综艺节目(Lakshminarayanan等人, 2017年)或蒙特卡洛(MC)辍学(Gal和Ghahramani, 2016年)估算不确定性。 对于MC退出,我们在测试时允许退出,并在高效网络中每次SiLU激活前插入速率p=0.2p=0.2的层. 所有结果都使用标准分割法在验证数据上显示.

blocks.en: We train all models from scratch using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) without weight decay, gradient clipping at 1.0, batch size 128, and an initial learning rate of 0.001 with cosine decay. Training lasts 200–1200 epochs, depending on model capacity and dataset. These durations were selected based on validation-performance plateaus observed in preliminary experiments.

blocks.en: 4.3 Varying the Posterior Sample Count
blocks.zh: 4.3 前后抽样计算的差异

blocks.en: Increasing the posterior sample count ( N N ) improves OOD detection performance (Figure 8 ) for both AU and EU, but no clear trend is observed in how entangled the measures are. The relative EU fraction, EU / TU \text{EU}/\text{TU} , also increases with N N , counteracting the effects of epistemic collapse. This trend must be interpreted in light of finite-sample bias: for independent predictions sampled from a fixed distribution over networks, the plug-in EU estimate is downward biased, with bias decreasing as N N increases. We therefore report jackknife-corrected estimates in Figure 8 ( Quenouille, 1956 ) . Appendix B describes the correction and its limitations.
blocks.zh: 增加后采样计数(N N )提高了非盟和欧盟的OD检测性能(图8),但在措施的缠绕程度方面没有观察到明确的趋势. 相对的欧盟分数, EU / TU\text{EU}/\text{TU}, 也随着 N N 的增加, 抵消了感官崩溃的影响. 必须根据有限的抽样偏差来解释这一趋势:对于从网络的固定分布中抽取的独立预测,欧盟的插头估计有向下偏差,随着NN的增加,偏差会减少。 因此,我们在图8(Quenouille,1956年)中报告刀修正估计数。 附 录 B描述了更正及其局限性。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The information-theoretic decomposition imposes structural constraints on the AU and EU pairs attainable from a finite set of posterior samples. Beyond the broad entropy bounds, an infeasible region remains in low-AU regimes. The first boundary curve severely impacts attainable combinations, restricting them to AU > EU \text{AU}>\text{EU} in this regime. Thus, AU and EU cannot be interpreted as independently varying coordinates for finite-sample predictions here.
blocks.zh: 信息理论分解对非盟和欧盟从有限的后遗症样本中获得的对子造成了结构性限制。 在广义的py界限之外,一个不可行的区域仍然处于低非盟制度。 第一个边界曲线严重影响到可实现的组合,将其限制在本制度中的AU > EU\text{AU}>\Text{EU}。 因此,不能将非盟和欧盟解释为这里有限的抽样预测的独立、不同的坐标。

blocks.en: These constraints provide one perspective on epistemic collapse. As is well-documented in the literature, larger models produce more highly confident predictions Guo et al. (2017) . Such predictions accumulate near the first infeasible boundary, where the geometry restricts the relative sizes of AU and EU. The boundary therefore offers a structural contribution to the observed decrease in the EU fraction as model capacity grows, although it is not the only cause of collapse. In our experiments, the number posterior samples ( N N ) in the ensemble also plays a role: increasing the ensemble size reduces epistemic collapse. Our derived bound AU ≤ log ⁡ ( 2 ) / N \text{AU}\leq\log(2)/N (Theorem 3 ) helps explain why. More generally, increasing the posterior sample count can lessen this particular geometric limitation, although it also incurs additional computational cost.
blocks.zh: 这些制约因素为癫痫崩溃提供了一个视角。 如文献所记载的,较大的模型产生了更高度自信的预测郭等人(2017年). 这种预测累积在第一个不可行的边界附近,在那里几何限制了非盟和欧盟的相对规模. 因此,边界在结构上有助于随着模型容量的增长而观察到的欧盟部分的减少,尽管这不是崩溃的唯一原因。 在我们的实验中,综艺节目中的数字后期样本(N N)也起到一定的作用: 增加综艺节目的尺寸可以减少感官崩溃. / N\ text{AU}leq\log(2)/N(定理3)帮助解释原因。 更一般地说,增加后取样数可以减少这种特殊的几何限制,尽管这也会造成额外的计算费用。

blocks.en: Our analysis is limited to the information-theoretic decomposition and does not generalize to other frameworks such as EPKL (Expected Pairwise Kullback-Leibler) ( Schweighofer et al., 2023 ) . We do not provide a method to eliminate the boundary effect at fixed posterior sample count. Future work could investigate alternative uncertainty frameworks, develop methods for interpreting or correcting finite-sample estimates, and test whether tiered strategies (e.g., ensembles of SWAG (Stochastic Weight Averaging Gaussian) ( Maddox et al., 2019 ) or dropout models ( Gal and Ghahramani, 2016 ) ) can approach the performance of larger ensembles at lower computational cost.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析仅限于信息理论分解,没有概括到其他框架,如EPKL(Expected Pairwise Kullback-Leibler)(Schweighofer等人,2023年)。 我们没有提供一种方法来消除固定的后遗症样本计数时的边界效应. 今后的工作可以调查其他的不确定性框架,制定解释或纠正有限抽样估计的方法,并测试分层战略(如SWAG的组合(Stochastic Weight Averaging Gaussian)(Maddox等人,2019年)或辍学模型(Gal和Ghahramani,2016年))是否能够以较低的计算成本接近较大组合的性能。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We characterize structural limits on the information-theoretic decomposition of predictive uncertainty for finite sets of posterior samples. The attainable AU–EU region has an infeasible boundary that depends on posterior sample count and class count. Simulations and experiments on CIFAR-10 and MNIST show how this geometry relates to observed uncertainty patterns, including changes in epistemic uncertainty with model capacity. These findings motivate interpreting information-theoretic estimates in light of finite-sample constraints. Extending the boundary analysis beyond the binary-class proof and developing practical mitigation strategies remain open directions.
blocks.zh: 我们描述的是,对于有限的几组后期样本,预测不确定性的信息理论分解结构限制。 可实现的非盟-欧盟区域有一个不可行的边界,它取决于后抽样数和类数。 CIFAR-10和MNIST的模拟和实验显示,这种几何学与观测到的不确定性模式有何关系,包括具有模型能力的认知不确定性的变化. 这些结论促使人们根据有限的抽样限制来解释信息理论估计数。 将边界分析扩大到二进制类证明之外,并制定实际缓解战略,仍然是开放方向。
